answer: A bounty bond stops bulk fakes. Each identity claims one willow plot at the wharf, locks 70 credits, and buys a jade seal bound to plot and key. First seal 38, k-th 38+7(k-1). Proving two identities share one jade seal earns a 45 bounty from the burned bond; false claims forfeit 70. The wharf registry lists every willow plot. 1,000 fakes pay 3,534,500, lock 70,000, for a 40,000 pool. Rented jade seals bear another key. Honest agents pay 38 once.
